abstract: Sertoli and Leydig cell functions were evaluated in men with testicular damage due either to cytotoxic chemotherapy (CCT) or radiotherapy (XRT). Serum immunoactive inhibin, follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), luteinizing hormone (LH) and testosterone concentrations were measured in 15 men (19-50 years) who had received 6-10 courses of combination CCT (mustine, vinblastine, procarbazine and prednisolone) for Hodgkin's disease 1-8 years earlier and 18 men (21-49 years) who had undergone unilateral orchidectomy for testicular seminoma followed by XRT (30 Gy) to the remaining testis, 1-4 years earlier. Normal men (n = 16, 19-36 years) acted as controls. Median inhibin (422 U/l) and testosterone (16.0 nmol/l) levels in the CCT-treated group were not significantly different from controls, whereas median FSH (14.5 IU/l) and LH (10.0 IU/l) levels were higher (p less than 0.0001 and p less than 0.001) than normal (2.9 and 5.5 IU/l). The median inhibin/FSH (I/FSH) ratio in the patients was lower (p less than 0.0001) than in the controls (33.8 vs. 187.0) as was the testosterone/LH (T/LH) ratio (1.7 vs. 3.8, p less than 0.001). In the XRT-treated group, both median inhibin (194.5 U/l) and testosterone (12.7 nmol/l) levels were lower (p less than 0.0001 and p less than 0.01) than normal (532.8 U/l and 20.0 nmol/l) in the presence of greatly elevated FSH (26.0 IU/l) and LH (14.5 IU/l) levels. In conclusion, CCT-induced testicular damage is associated with subtle Sertoli and Leydig cell dysfunction demonstrated by the reduced I/FSH and T/LH ratios; however, compensatory mechanisms maintain normal testosterone and inhibin levels.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 細胞毒性化学療法(CCT)または放射線療法(XRT)による精巣障害を有する男性について、セルトリ細胞およびライディッヒ細胞の機能を評価した。ホジキン病に対し1～8年前に6～10コース のCCT(ナイトロジェンマスタード、ビンブラスチン、プロカルバジン、プレドニゾロン)を受けた男性15人(19～50歳)と、1～4年前に精巣セミノーマに対し片側精巣摘除後、残存精巣に30GyのXRTを受けた男性18人(21～49歳)を対象とした。正常男性16人(19～36歳)を対照とした。CCT群の血清免疫活性インヒビン(中央値422 U/l)とテストステロン(中央値16.0 nmol/l)は対照と有意差がなかったが、FSH(中央値14.5 IU/l)およびLH(中央値10.0 IU/l)は正常(それぞれ2.9、5.5 IU/l)より高値であった(p<0.0001、p<0.001)。患者のインヒビン/FSH(I/FSH)比は対照より低く(p<0.0001)(33.8 対 187.0)、テストステロン/LH(T/LH)比も低かった(p<0.001)(1.7 対 3.8)。XRT群ではインヒビン(中央値194.5 U/l)とテストステロン(中央値12.7 nmol/l)が正常(532.8 U/l、20.0 nmol/l)より低く(p<0.0001、p<0.01)、FSH(中央値26.0 IU/l)およびLH(中央値14.5 IU/l)は著明に高値であった。結論として、CCTによる精巣障害は、I/FSH比とT/LH比の低下で示される軽微なセルトリ細胞およびライディッヒ細胞機能障害を伴うが、代償機構によりテストステロンとインヒビンは正常に保たれる。(抄録は250語で打ち切られている)
